thesis: Mind Twist turns excess mana into random, scalable hand destruction, making acceleration especially punishing because the opponent can lose an entire plan before deploying it.

playbook.role: Cast it for enough cards to cripple the opponent while preserving the mana needed to control the board. Early artifact mana makes small Twists decisive; late copies can strip a carefully rebuilt hand.
